# opnsense_nginx_limit_request_connection (Resource)

nginx connection limits (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Access ▸ Connection Limits**, plugin `os-nginx`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_nginx_limit_request_connection" "api" {
  description = "API rate limit"
  limit_zone  = [opnsense_nginx_limit_zone.per_client.id]
  burst       = 40
  nodelay     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description.
- `limit_zone` (Set of String) Limit Zone.

### Optional

- `burst` (Number) Burst (HTTP Only). Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `connection_count` (Number) Connection Count (Streams Only). Defaults to `5`.
- `nodelay` (Boolean) No Delay (HTTP Only). Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx connection limit.
